title: The Future is Agentic: Definitions, Perspectives, and Open Challenges of Multi-Agent Recommender Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Proposed conceptual evaluation via a multi-agent user simulation framework (MASsim) where synthetic user agents interact iteratively with the recommender system, allowing an evaluation agent to log and aggregate data to detect feedback loops and the over-recommendation of popular items.

Proposed offline evaluation using parameterized synthetic user profiles to simulate diverse user behaviors, allowing a reporter agent to analyze aggregated interaction logs and diagnose systemic demographic skews before real-world deployment.
